# Bundled dependencies

- **gifenc 1.0.3**, `gifenc.js` copied unchanged from `package/dist/gifenc.esm.js` in https://registry.npmjs.org/gifenc/-/gifenc-1.0.3.tgz. MIT license: `gifenc.LICENSE`.
- **omggif 1.0.10**, `omggif.js` copied unchanged from https://registry.npmjs.org/omggif/-/omggif-1.0.10.tgz. Its MIT license is preserved in the file header.

Both run locally in the browser. No remote conversion service or runtime package installation is required.
